QUOTE: "The user retries by tapping "Try Again", which re-sends the same post once." and "**2. Manual retry (`retryFailedPost`, `app/actions/remote/post.ts:228-307`)** ... The only caller is the "Try Again" item in the failed-post bottom sheet ... Nothing calls it automatically."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says retry occurs only via the user's "Try Again" choice and names `retryFailedPost` as the function invoked.
